scientific_limitations: The closed-form prefactor is established for the perfect-transmission block architecture and strict ordering \(\alpha_3>\alpha_2>\alpha_1\).
The source's complete numerical generator was not reconstructed, so no replacement numerical Table 5 values are claimed.
Repeated/resonant modes or vanishing reachability coefficients require modified asymptotics.
title: A missing entry-amplitude factor in Wolbachia QSD convergence times
